post.text:
Erika Kirk reveals that at a meeting with donors in August (the Zionist donor meeting at the Hamptons?) Charlie Kirk was asked what would happen to TPUSA if he died.

Does anyone else find that a strange question to ask a healthy 31 year old just weeks before he was assassinated? https://t.co/oA189dl8M9

description.description: A scene from The Megyn Kelly Show on SiriusXM featuring an interview between Megyn Kelly (left) and another woman (right). Kelly, dressed in a black patterned suit, is holding a microphone and a notebook, actively speaking and gesturing with her hands. The other woman, in a white suit, sits opposite her, listening attentively. They are seated in white chairs with a small table between them holding flowers and tissue boxes against a dark background with some greenery.

tweetMedia.transcription: In August, before all this happened, he had an event where he had some donors at. And one of the first questions they asked was, God forbid if something happens to you, what would happen next, the turning point? And Charlie made a really interesting point. He said, companies, you know, example, Apple, Macintosh, he said, they're founder-led. He said, but what I have built is, will one day, if I'm not around, be vision-led. And he had made mention at the end, like, you know, Erica will do a great job running it.
